description: V1.7 M5-C third-party dependency license policy (roadmap §12.3 / lts-policy §9). The repository's OWN license (AGPL-3.0-only) is recorded separately in repository-license.json and is never used to allow/deny a dependency. SPDX IDs are parsed conservatively from CycloneDX license.id / license.expression. A component license is ALLOWED iff it matches the allow set; DENIED licenses block; REVIEW licenses are reported (documented) but do not block; UNKNOWN (unrecognized/non-SPDX) and MISSING (no license metadata) block unless covered by an exact, unexpired license-exceptions.json entry. This allow/deny/review set is aligned to the licenses actually present in the generated Maven + Web CycloneDX SBOMs; review-only licenses are documented in the note below. It is intentionally narrow -- not a kitchen-sink allowlist.
firstPartyNote: Components whose CycloneDX group / PURL namespace matches a firstPartyGroups entry are the project's own reactor modules (AGPL-3.0-only, the repository license). They are FIRST-PARTY and are excluded from third-party license decisions, consistent with keeping the repository license separate from third-party policy (roadmap §12.3 / lts-policy §9).
reviewNote: Review-only licenses are reported and counted but do not block the gate; they require periodic human re-review per lts-policy §9. Aligned/confirmed against the real generated Maven + Web CycloneDX SBOMs during M5-C: review covers weak-copyleft (LGPL-2.1/3.0 variants, present in both SBOMs) and the GPL-2.0-with-classpath-exception (classpath exception, a Maven dependency) and CDDL/EPL-1.0 (Jakarta/JUnit ecosystem). See the normalized license-decision report for exact component-level review counts.
